content:
[Intro]
[D]

[Verse 1-1]
[D]I'm feeling rough, I'm feeling
[G]raw, I'm in the prime of my life.
[D]
Let's make some music, make some
[G]money, find some models for wives.

[Verse 1-2]
[D]I'll move to Paris, shoot some
[G]heroin, and fuck with the stars.
[D]
You man the island and the co-
[G]caine and the elegant cars.
[D]

[Pre-Chorus 1-1]
[G]This is our decision, to
live fast and die young.
We've got the vision,
now let's have some
[D]fun.

[Pre-Chorus 1-2]
[G]Yeah, it's overwhelming, but
what else can we do.
Get jobs in offices, and
wake up for the morning com-
[D]mute

[Bridge]
[A]Forget about our
mothers and our friends
[D/F#]We're
[G]fated to pretend

[Chorus 1]
[D]
[G]To pretend
[D]We're
[G]fated to prete-
[D]nd
[G]To pretend
[D]
[G]

[Verse 2-1]
[D]I'll miss the playgrounds and the
[G]animals and digging up worms
[D]
I'll miss the comfort of my
[G]mother and the weight of the world
[D]

[Verse 2-2]
[D]I'll miss my sister, miss my
[G]father, miss my dog and my home
[D]
Yeah,
I'll miss the boredom and the
[G]freedom and the time spent alone.
[D]

[Pre-Chorus 2-1]
[G]There's really nothing,
nothing we can do Love
must be forgotten,
life can always start up anew.
[D]

[Pre-Chorus 2-2]
[G]The models will have children, we'll
get a divorce
We'll find some more models,
everything must run it's course.
[D]
We'll

[Bridge]
[A]choke on our vomit and
that will be the end
[D/F#]We were
[G]fated to pretend

[Chorus 2]
[D]
[G]To pretend
[D]We're
[G]fated to prete-
[D]nd
[G]To pretend
[D]
[G]Say Yeah, yeah, ye-
[D]ah
[G]Yeah, yeah, ye-
[D]ah
[G]Yeah, yeah, ye-
[D]ah
[G]Yeah, yeah, ye-
[D]
[G]
title: Time To Pretend
tuning: E A D G B E
